mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.iam_permission_resource WHERE id = #{resourceId} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_permission_resource SET publish_status = 'PUBLISHED', updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{resourceId} AND publish_status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.iam_permission_resource SET publish_status = 'DEPRECATED', updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{resourceId} AND publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_tenant_feature ( tenant_id, feature_code, enabled, changed_by, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT tenant.id, #{featureCode}, true, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId} FROM public.iam_tenant tenant WHERE tenant.is_deleted = false ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, feature_code) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.iam_tenant_menu_config ( tenant_id, menu_permission_id, hidden, changed_by, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT tenant.id, #{permissionId}, false, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId} FROM public.iam_tenant tenant WHERE tenant.is_deleted = false ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, menu_permission_id) DO NOTHING
